articles.summary: NEW YORK, Sept. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- IREN Limited (NASDAQ: IREN) (“IREN”) today announced that its 2GW Sweetwater Hub (Sweetwater 1 and Sweetwater 2) has been conditionally included in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (“ERCOT”) Batch Zero process as Base Load.
articles.title: IREN’s 2GW Sweetwater Hub Included as Base Load in ERCOT Batch Zero
